info.title: Gringo Funnels API
info.description: Versioned, tenant-scoped API for Gringo Funnels. Sites organize one hostname namespace with multiple mounted content types. New integrations should use /sites/* for custom domains; /funnels/{funnelId}/domains remains a backward-compatible facade.

get.description: Sites are hostname namespaces that organize multiple mounted funnels, listicles, quizzes, and pages. Requires funnels:read.

post.description: Requires funnels:write. This does not connect or modify a domain.

409.description: Site slug is already in use

get.summary: Get a Site, mounts, and domains

patch.summary: Update a Site name or internal slug
patch.description: Requires funnels:write. It never changes DNS or a connected hostname.

409.description: Site slug is already in use

delete.description: Requires funnels:write. A Site with connected domains cannot be deleted.

409.description: Remove Site domains before deleting the Site

get.description: Requires funnels:read. Public routing selects the longest matching mount path.

post.summary: Mount a funnel, listicle, quiz, or page
post.description: Requires funnels:write. A funnel can be mounted once, and a mount path must be unique within its Site. If the Site already has any custom domain, an active custom_domains entitlement is required because this changes live hostname routing.

409.description: Funnel already mounted or mount path is in use

patch.summary: Move or reorder a mounted funnel
patch.description: Requires funnels:write. If the Site has any custom domain, an active custom_domains entitlement is required because this changes live hostname routing.

delete.summary: Unmount a funnel from a Site
delete.description: Requires funnels:write and remains available without a paid entitlement. The funnel and immutable releases remain available; only this Site route is removed. A mount used as a custom-domain compatibility anchor cannot be removed until those domains are removed.

409.description: Mount anchors one or more Site domains; remove those domains first

post.summary: Start a custom hostname claim for a Site
post.description: Requires funnels:read and domains:write plus an active custom_domains subscription. It returns exact DNS records and never edits a registrar automatically.

201.description: Hostname claim created; response includes DNS records

patch.summary: Recheck Site hostname ownership and TLS
patch.description: Requires funnels:read and domains:write plus an active custom_domains subscription. It never writes DNS.

delete.description: Requires funnels:read and domains:write. Removal stays available after a subscription ends so a customer can always stop serving a hostname. It removes Gringo's mapping, not customer DNS records.

post.summary: Rotate a pending one-time Site hostname claim
post.description: Requires funnels:read and domains:write plus an active custom_domains subscription. It invalidates the previous pending TXT value and returns the replacement exactly once. Verified claims cannot be rotated.

200.description: Replacement claim issued; response includes the one-time TXT value

put.summary: Upload one predeclared file with exact length and checksum

post.summary: Run quality gates and publish the bundle

get.summary: List custom domains and DNS/TLS state
get.description: Backward-compatible funnel-domain facade. New integrations should list domains through /sites/{siteId}/domains so one hostname can serve multiple mounted funnels.

post.summary: Connect an external hostname through Cloudflare for SaaS
post.description: Backward-compatible facade that resolves the funnel's Site. New integrations should use POST /sites/{siteId}/domains. Requires an active custom_domains subscription and returns 402 subscription_required when absent.

201.description: Hostname created; response contains exact DNS verification records

patch.summary: Recheck DNS ownership and certificate state
patch.description: Backward-compatible funnel-domain facade. Requires an active custom_domains subscription.

delete.description: Backward-compatible funnel-domain facade. Requires an active custom_domains subscription.

post.description: Idempotent lead ingestion with optional bounded first-touch attribution. Set emailMarketingConsent=true only after an explicit marketing opt-in; analytics consent is never reused. Never send raw gclid/fbclid values. Demo fixtures are never returned by this API or counted as activation.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Unique retry key (8–128 safe ASCII characters).

200.description: Existing lead returned for an idempotent retry
Paginated leads for the authenticated workspace

mountPath.description: Safe Site path. Platform routes such as /api and /_next are reserved.

claimRecordValue.description: One-time TXT ownership value. Present only on a newly issued or rotated claim.

conversion.description: Measured conversion fraction, or null when aggregate lead and view totals cannot establish the same deduplicated visitor cohort. Null is not zero; do not derive a replacement percentage from the operational totals.

emailMarketingConsent.description: Explicit opt-in to marketing e-mail for this capture.

LeadAttributionInput.description: Privacy-safe first-touch acquisition fields. Send a pathname only (never a full landing/referrer URL). Raw advertising click identifiers are not accepted or stored.

Forbidden.description: The scoped credential does not grant this operation

SubscriptionRequired.description: The workspace lacks an active entitlement for this paid capability. Agents must show this error to the owner and must not mutate DNS or retry around billing.

details.description: Entitlement feature and current state, when safe to disclose.

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body exceeds the endpoint-specific bound

TooManyRequests.description: Tenant and endpoint allowance exceeded (600 requests per 60 seconds)

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required API protection or dependency is unavailable
